three_strongest_aspects: A dominant landmark anchors both composition and traversal.
The critical path changes direction and creates staged reveals.
NPC roles cluster around plausible route activities rather than random spacing.
three_weakest_aspects: The map has no secondary landmark to balance the dominant landmark's visual weight.
recommended_modifications: Compose a smaller activity landmark off-axis from the bridge.
limitations: Structural heuristic only; visual review and playtesting remain required.
